dimensions.note: The model holds no credentials. The Jev key is read by @swamp/typesafe-ai from the vault. load withholds any turn that looks like it holds a secret (token, key, password, email, long hex): stored text is a placeholder and the Jev steps are skipped (tested). match and execute run only `swamp` on the PATH with fixed arguments: the recipe's regex captures digits only and they go in with --literal-inputs, so turn text is never a swamp input; only allowlisted extensions (@swamp/*, @mesgme/*, @webframp/*, @puddleworks/*, plus the repo's own puddlerouter.yaml `allow:` list, which only the repo owner writes) are pulled or run, and only read-only recipes. Local recipes in puddlerouter.yaml take captures only of a declared shape (int, repo, word), checked before they become --literal-inputs method inputs. raise passes only the cleaned turn (never a withheld one) to @webframp/github's create_issue, which uses the user's gh login; the repo and key are fixed by the workflow. Step 6b caches hold no turn text: the route cache is keyed by the sourceRef's hash and stores only Jev's choice, confidence, yes probability, pick and the candidate names; the search cache stores the query's hash and extension names/descriptions that search returned; the result cache stores a recipe's rendered answer under a hash of recipe id and captures, only for local recipes that set cacheFor. A withheld turn gets no route entry because Jev is never asked. Step 6c (recipe packs): sync runs only `swamp extension search --label puddlerouter-recipe`, `extension list` and `extension pull <name> --yes` with fixed words and a pack name from the registry. A pack is pulled only if its name passes the allowlist (the same check as an extension), so a stranger's pack with the label is skipped and reported. Each pack recipe is checked by the same zod schema and allowlist as a local recipe (extension, method and definition are patterns, captures only of a declared shape, run with --literal-inputs), and again when match/execute compile the index, so a shrunk allowlist applies at once. A pack author inside the allowlist is trusted like the owner's own puddlerouter.yaml: a recipe is read-only by flag, not by inspection. Workflow files are read only from the paths swamp lists for the pack under workflows/*.yaml (a path with '..' is skipped); the index holds recipe definitions and pack names, no turn text.
load and reply log at info on entry and on completion with structured properties (tested); reply logs the action and reason. Neither logs the turn text.

load throws on an unreadable turn file before writing (tested). reply inputs are validated by zod; a missing route answer, a missing or failed decide answer, an unsure answer and an incomplete turn are each recorded with a reason and pass, so the workflow fails open (each tested). match fails open: a failed or unparseable search gives kind none; execute turns an unknown recipe, a failed pull or run, bad JSON and missing data into ok=false with a reason, and reply passes (each tested). parseConfig never throws: invalid YAML, a bad allow entry or a bad local recipe is dropped and reported, and loadConfig falls back to the defaults for a missing or unreadable file (each tested). A capture of the wrong shape makes the recipe fail with 'bad input', and reply passes. Step 6b: recallRoute never throws (a missing, malformed, expired or unreadable entry is a miss, each tested); a failed cache read or write in match and execute is swallowed and the search or recipe runs as before; a failed search is not cached; a failed recipe run is not cached; a turn Jev gave no route for is not cached (each tested). Step 6c: syncPacks throws only when the registry cannot be searched, so the old index stays; a failed pull, an unreadable or invalid YAML file, a workflow that is not one model_method step, an undeclared or mismatched input, a disallowed extension, a bad pattern or a clashing id is an entry in errors and the rest loads (each tested). withPacks never throws: a missing index adds nothing, an invalid one is ignored with a note, a stale one is used with a note, a failing store is ignored (each tested).

33 unit tests: cleaning, hashing, empty, complete and withheld turns, secret patterns (12 positive, 6 negative), cut-offs, every reply reason, live block text, shadow wouldAction, elapsedMs, load failure, one resource written, log order. 26 hook and workflow tests, including the route and decide guards. Step 6 adds tests for the allowlist, the config parser, local recipe matching, running and rendering, capture shapes, and match reading puddlerouter.yaml. Step 6b adds tests for recall hit, miss, expiry, read error and malformed entry; withRecall (fills, fresh wins, miss); reply writing and not writing the route cache; the search cache hit, expiry, failed search and allowlist applied after; the result cache opt-in, expiry, failure and cacheFor parsing; and workflow guards for recall on route, decide and pick. Step 6c adds tests for parseRecipe, recipeFromWorkflow (tag, step and input rules), syncPacks (pull when missing or stale, none when current, allowlist, bad workflows, built-in id clash, search failure, path guard), withPacks (order, missing, broken, stale, clashes), a pack recipe through findMatch and executeRecipe, match reading the index, and the sync workflow's name, step, schedule and manifest entry. Live: sync, match and execute against the published pack.

Each method writes one fixed-name resource as a new version; repeating a run adds a version and changes nothing else. The issue is keyed by the turn's sourceRef, so a repeated turn reuses the issue (verified live). Step 6b: a cache entry is a deterministic function of the turn, so rewriting it is harmless; reply skips the write when every answer came from the cache. Step 6c: sync writes one fixed-name recipe-index version; pulling a current pack is skipped, so repeating a sync changes nothing but syncedAt.
No external API; Jev is called by the @swamp/typesafe-ai step in the workflow.
load reads the turn file with Deno.readTextFile and holds no handle. The hook, which creates the file, removes it.

Manifest publishes README, LICENSE, the model and the router workflow (not the eval workflows). README has no IPs, hostnames, account ids or personal paths; private visibility. The manifest now also publishes the recipes-sync workflow; its README section names no host, account or personal path. Re-reviewed 2026-10-16: since the 2026-10-13 review only README.md changed (the status line, and a note that the hook judges its skip rules on the typed text); the model, the _lib files, both published workflows and the manifest are unchanged, so every other verdict stands. The changed lines name no IP, host, account or personal path.
Plain z.object schemas with enums and iso datetimes; no passthrough.

turn, reply, match, result and recall: lifetime 14d, garbageCollection 2000. routeCache 7d, searchCache and resultCache 1d, garbageCollection 1 per instance (the latest version is all that is read). Age is also checked in code from cachedAt, so reuse does not depend on when swamp collects. recipeIndex: 7d, garbageCollection 1 (only the latest is read); its age is checked in code and a stale index is still used.
Not a lifecycle model; stateless per-turn methods plus caches that expire.
Methods change nothing outside swamp data.

load writes turn/turn, reply reply/reply, recall recall/recall; the caches use distinct prefixes (route-v1-, search-, result-) because readResource takes an instance name without the spec, so no two specs share a name. Checked field by field: every schema field is written for reply (including cached), recall, routeCache, searchCache, resultCache and result (including cached). recipeIndex is written as recipe-index, a name no other spec uses.

recall, match and execute read their own cache entries with context.readResource (never dataRepository, never `swamp data`); the result is parsed with zod before use. match and execute read recipe-index with context.readResource and parse it with zod before use.

Not yet published (swamp extension version gives currentPublished null), so the version stays 2026.10.13.2 and needs no upgrades entry. The recipeIndex spec, the sync method and the sync workflow are additive.
